Initial release of EB Video — Edit and Export Video Clips.

- Edit raw video footage (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM up to 500MB) into shareable, professionally rendered clips.
- Fast cloud-based processing (typically 30–60 seconds), outputs 1080p MP4 videos.
- Automatic connection setup with a free NEMO_TOKEN if needed; handles authentication, session, and video upload.
- Simple workflows for uploading videos, trimming, adding music, and managing exports or credits.
- Clear error handling for file size, format, rate limits, and authentication issues.
- Designed for content creators and marketers needing fast, quality edits.
